sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a plump harbour seal lying on its belly. Draw this exact seal as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body: the plump grey speckled body with its cream chest, lying on its belly as in image 1, from the chest at the front to the narrow hind end, without head, without its front flippers and without its tail flippers: no flippers drawn on it; the top of the neck, normally under the head, rounded; the hind end rounded where the tail flippers join.
2. the head: the seal's round head with its small dark nose, its long whiskers and its rosy cheeks, turned as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no eyebrows, no mouth — keep the nose, the whiskers, the speckles and the rosy cheeks; its bottom edge, under the chin, rounded.
3. one front flipper: the near front flipper of image 1 (the one in front of the belly, on the right) drawn whole, from its rounded shoulder at the top down to its fingered tip, as in image 1.
4. the tail flippers: the two hind flippers raised up behind as in image 1, together as one piece, with a rounded base where they join the body.
5. a small beach ball with red, yellow, blue and white segments.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a plump harbour seal; image 2 shows the same seal cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the seal's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the seal in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the seal's left eye (the bigger eye, on the right of image 1): a big dark round eye with a white sparkle, as it is in image 1.
2. the same eye wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, with its white sparkle.
3. the same eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc.
5. the same eye sad: looking down, its upper lid tilted up towards the middle, a thin shine of a welling tear along its bottom rim.
6. the same eye crying: gently squeezed shut, a soft downward-curving line (a sad closed eye, not a smile), a few small lashes, and one small light-blue teardrop just below its outer end.
7. its eyebrow as it is in image 1: a thin dark arched line.
8. the same eyebrow sad: tilted up at its inner end.
9. the mouth as it is in image 1: a small happy closed smile under the nose, just the line, without the nose.
10. the mouth wide open in a big happy bark, the inside pink, without the nose.
11. the mouth open in a small round 'o', without the nose.
12. the mouth in a small sad frown, without the nose.
13. the mouth sobbing: a small open downturned frown with a little pink inside, trembling, without the nose.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.
